questions.prompt: 다음 <보기>와 같이 괄호 안의 단어를 이용하여 문장을 완성할 때 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.passage: <보기> (the building, build, his father). → The building was built by his father.
choices: (the cookies, baked, Jane) → The cookies were baked by Jane.
(the watch, find, he) → The watch was found by him.
(the bus, stop, the policeman) → The bus was stop by the policeman.
(the letter, write, she) → The letter was written by her.
(the ball, hit, Chan-ho) → The ball was hit by Chan-ho.
questions.explanation: was stop→was stopped.

questions.prompt: 다음 우리말을 영작 할 때 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? (답 2개)
questions.passage:
너는 방을 청소 해야만 한다.
= You ____ clean your room.
questions.explanation: 의무 have to = must. (you는 2인칭이라 has to 불가)

questions.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 부분과 바꿔 쓸 수 있는 것은?
questions.passage: You [[don't have to]] take this medicine.
questions.explanation: don't have to = need not.

questions.prompt: 다음 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말은?
questions.passage:
Minji must wash the dishes.
= Minji ____ wash the dishes.
questions.explanation: must = has to (3인칭 단수 현재).

questions.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 부분과 바꾸어 쓸 수 있는 것은?
questions.passage: You [[must]] be on time.
questions.explanation: must = have to (의무).

questions.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
questions.passage: Kate's room is so dirty. Her mom will be angry. So she ____ clean the room soon.
questions.explanation: 3인칭 단수 she는 has to.

questions.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
questions.passage:
A: Tom, do we have a word test today?
B: Not today. It'll be next Friday.
A: Really? Then, I ____ study today.
questions.explanation: 시험 없으므로 don't have to.

questions.prompt: 다음 우리말에 맞도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말은?
questions.passage:
You ____ visit her again.
(너는 그녀를 다시 방문할 필요가 없다.)
questions.explanation: ~할 필요가 없다 = don't have to.

questions.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞지 않은 것은?
questions.passage: Minsu has to ____.
choices: get up early in the morning
questions.explanation: has to 뒤는 동사원형. reads→read.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
questions.passage: You ____ be kind to others.
questions.explanation: have not to는 비문. don't have to/must not이 맞음.

questions.prompt: 다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은?
questions.passage:
A: Do I have to go to the dentist, mom?
B: ____
questions.explanation: have to 의문 대답은 don't have to.

questions.prompt: 다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
questions.passage:
A: Must I leave now?
B: No. you ____ leave now.
questions.explanation: No 대답이므로 don't have to.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장과 뜻이 같은 것을 고르면?
questions.passage: You don't have to go to the party.
choices: You must not go to the party.
You need not go to the party.
You should not go to the party.
You may not go to the party.
You can not go to the party.
questions.explanation: don't have to = need not.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분이 의미상 자연스럽지 못한 것은?
questions.passage:
① We [[have to]] pay. It's free.
② I [[have to]] say it was my fault.
③ Sorry, but I [[have to]] leave now.
④ Policemen [[have to]] wear a uniform.
⑤ You [[don't have to]] do it if you don't want to.
choices: We have to pay. It's free.
I have to say it was my fault.
Sorry, but I have to leave now.
Policemen have to wear a uniform.
You don't have to do it if you don't want to.
questions.explanation: 무료인데 '내야 한다'는 모순. don't have to pay.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
choices: She have to wake up early.
He don't need to come here.
Does she has to wait here?
Do you have to go to the library?
I have to finish my homework yesterday.
questions.explanation: ④만 옳음. ①has ②doesn't ③have ⑤yesterday 불일치.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: Tom must don't go home now.
Monica has to take care of her sister.
You must not be late for school.
I don't have to return this book.
Does she have to wear this dress?
questions.explanation: must don't→must not.

questions.prompt: 다음 대화의 흐름상 빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
questions.passage:
Semi: The weather is very nice. Let's go for a walk.
Kevin: Sorry, but I have a headache. ____
choices: I have to take a rest.
He has to help my mom.
You have to make a house.
They have to write a report.
She has to take some pictures.
questions.explanation: 두통이 있으므로 '쉬어야 한다'.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장의 흐름상 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
questions.passage:
• You (A)____ answer my questions if you don't want to.
• You (B)____ make a noise in the library.
• You (C)____ finish your homework by tomorrow.
choices: must / should not / don't have to
should not / don't have to / should not
don't have to / should not / must
don't have to / must / should not
should not / must / don't have to
questions.explanation: don't have to / should not / must.

questions.prompt: 다음 빈칸 ⓐ∼ⓔ에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것은?
questions.passage:
• I can hear you. You ⓐ____ shout.
• Plants ⓑ____ have water in order to live.
• Jason can't join us tonight. He ⓒ____ work late.
• Last week Anne broke her arm and ⓓ____ go to the hospital.
• There's an elevator in this building, so we ⓔ____ climb the stairs.
questions.explanation: ⓒ He has to work late만 적절. ⓐdon't have to ⓑmust ⓓhad to ⓔdon't have to.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 짝지어진 두 문장의 의미가 서로 다른 것은?
choices: You don't have to leave early. = You must not leave early.
They must be careful at dark night. = They have to be careful at dark night.
He doesn't have to go now. = He doesn't need to go now.
You don't need to spend a lot of money on new clothes. = You need not spend a lot of money on new clothes.
Finish your homework, or you can't watch TV. = If you don't finish your homework, you can't watch TV.
questions.explanation: don't have to(필요없음) ≠ must not(금지).
